digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and persistent tickets clone management
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume diverges during redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, and ensure-script must converge it with or without REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT set.

The ensure-script must fetch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets, record local and prior-remote tips, and fail gracefully (preserving local tip and returning success) if credentials are absent or origin is unreachable.

Pre-epoch local clones whose pre-fetch local tip is an ancestor of a readable prior remote tip must adopt the newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit through a narrow under-write-lock adoption path; all other divergent states must preserve the local tip with operator warning.

The autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS must include infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh so that ensure-script changes trigger deployment, and ensure execution must remain outside the PAT block to preserve best-effort vote safety.
Store write failures after post_vote in artifact_emit.py must never undo or wedge an already-cast Gerrit vote and must remain best-effort.
